FIELD NOTES · A BETTER WAY TO READ
READING & TECHNOLOGY

A small tool for a wider world

Reading in another language opens a window into new ideas. A helpful translation should stay close to the original, so that readers can compare both versions without leaving the page.

Good tools respect the page. They preserve useful links, keep the original words, and make it easy to return to the way things were.

Keep the experience simple

  • Click once to translate the current webpage.
  • Click again to restore the original text.
